_comment: Maps each UTS spec module (a dir under specification/uts/) to its target test directories. Output dir = testRoot + '/' + tier entry. Swift has no package concept, so the directory is the full story. An optional 'notes' field points (relative to this skill dir) to a per-module ably-js -> ably-cocoa translation reference, read before translating that module. Used by the uts-to-swift skill.
